responsibility: Declares the S/390 D front-end support entry points and binds them to the D target-hook macros. This header is the small interface layer that lets the D front end call the S/390-specific version-definition and target-info registration routines implemented in s390-d.cc.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/s390/s390-d.cc, this file is only the D-front-end interface shim: it declares the S/390 D hook functions and maps TARGET_D_* macros to them, without implementing the target-version or target-info logic.
